audit_events_hash_material_version_check.name: audit_events_hash_material_version_check
audit_events_hash_material_version_check.value:
(
        ("audit_events"."action" = 'journal.posted' AND "audit_events"."hash_material_version" = 'journal-posted-v1')
        OR ("audit_events"."action" = 'period.transition' AND "audit_events"."hash_material_version" = 'period-transition-v1')
        OR (
          "audit_events"."action" NOT IN ('journal.posted', 'period.transition')
          AND "audit_events"."hash_material_version" = 'tenant-business-v1'
        )
      )

audit_outbox_pair_contract_names_check.name: audit_outbox_pair_contract_names_check
audit_outbox_pair_contract_names_check.value:
length("audit_outbox_pair_contract"."audit_action") BETWEEN 1 AND 120
        AND length("audit_outbox_pair_contract"."outbox_topic") BETWEEN 1 AND 120
        AND length("audit_outbox_pair_contract"."aggregate_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 120
        AND "audit_outbox_pair_contract"."audit_action" !~ E'[\r\n]'
        AND "audit_outbox_pair_contract"."outbox_topic" !~ E'[\r\n]'
        AND "audit_outbox_pair_contract"."aggregate_type" !~ E'[\r\n]'
